title: A distinguished triangle with zero third map is a biproduct triangle
statement: In a pretriangulated category with zero object, integer shifts, additive structure and binary biproducts [def-weil-triangulated-category], let $X\xrightarrow{u}Y\xrightarrow{v}Z\xrightarrow{w}X[1]$ be a distinguished triangle with $w=0$. Then there is an isomorphism $e:Y\xrightarrow{\sim}X\oplus Z$ onto the binary biproduct compatible with the triangle, that is $e\circ u=\iota_X$ (the biproduct inclusion) and $v=\pi_Z\circ e$ (the biproduct projection).
